scope.predictor: Warm model, request compilation + tokenization + synchronized inference + typed formatting and validation; model loading excluded.
scope.http_loopback: Same warm model over real loopback HTTP, fresh TCP connection each request; includes JSON encoding, server, synchronized inference, response decoding and validation. No external Internet.
scope.cache: request-local only; no cross-request result or prefix reuse
scope.percentile_method: linear interpolation at (n-1)*q, successful measured attempts; failures and warmups retained separately
scope.comparability: A hosted API includes network, routing and service scheduling; no direct model-only speedup may be inferred from that difference.
